items.a: You want an ad that stands out without spending time on it: Pro ({tiers.pro.priceTier}), the most complete for the price. For a big launch or a demanding brand: Studio ({tiers.studio.priceTier}). Small budget: Essential ({priceCreation}). And if you want to learn to do it yourself: I guide you ({price}).

items.q: What’s the difference between the three options?
items.a: The level of detail and what’s included. Essential is a real, polished ad of about {tiers.essentielle.videoSeconds} s, delivered within {tiers.essentielle.deliveryHours} hours. Pro adds a custom world, voice-over, the square format and {tiers.pro.revisionsIncluded}. Studio goes all the way: several 3D scenes, 3 ad openings to test, every format and {tiers.studio.revisionsIncluded}. The “Compare the three options” table has every detail.
You do. Once paid and delivered, you can use, publish and edit it freely, including in ads. I don’t reuse it without your consent.

items.q: I’m a complete beginner. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes. With a creation, there’s nothing to know: you describe, I build. With “I guide you”, I adapt my explanations to your level.
The options cover ads and motion videos. For a website, email me at {contact}: I’ll reply with a quote.

items.q: What if I change my mind?
items.a: You have a 14-day right of withdrawal, under the conditions set out in the terms of sale. By ordering, you ask me to start right away, and you lose this right once my reply or your creation has been fully delivered.
Yes. Payment is handled by Stripe. I never see your card details.
